findings.observation: The medium skin, full cheeks, sharply defined brows, aquiline nose, softly full closed mouth, and black halo echo Orin, but the greatly enlarged round eyes, shortened lower face, softened jaw, and smooth doll-like planes read as a child rather than the source's unmistakable 28-year-old adult woman.

The source's ordinary lean-to-average, undefined construction is inflated into a visibly stockier broad torso, thicker upper arms, and heavier short legs, changing Orin's relative widths and mass beyond required chibi compaction.

Both draped sleeves lead to coherent forearms, readable wrists, and two complete empty hands with separated fingers and no duplicate anatomy; hand scale remains restrained relative to the corrected chibi body.
The clean but deliberately tousled black curls preserve the summon’s dense front and side coils-halo silhouette, gathered volume, irregular curl tips, and absence of added hair accents.

The terracotta-black draped robe retains its belting and openings, low-profile waist toggles, articulated trouser knees, layered edges, visible wear, wrapped keepsake cord, hanging tally elements, ankle wraps, and strapped sandals. No tattoo or unrelated accessory is added.

Measured visually from the highest curl to the chin against highest curl to the lower sandal sole, the complete head-and-hair unit occupies approximately 35% of standing height, about 2.85 heads total, clearly inside the required 32–36% / 2.75–3.1 range.
Exactly one complete subject appears; the highest curls, head, both empty hands, all robe and cord ends, both sandaled feet, and grounding shadow remain fully inside generous margins.
The planted asymmetric stance, separated empty hands, broad curl halo, cinched robe, and articulated lower silhouette read clearly as a weaponless ready-idle pose at combat-icon scale.

The worn draped cloth, plain ties, keepsake/tally cords, loose trousers, wraps, and sandals remain ordinary mortal belongings; no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.

attempts.retryReason: The sole output satisfies the 32–36% chibi ratio and preserves hair, wardrobe, cords, framing, combat read, and one-star ceiling, but it loses the source-bound adult identity and body: the face reads childlike/doll-like rather than 28, and the torso, arms, and legs are generically inflated into a stockier build instead of Orin's ordinary lean-to-average construction. Any separately assigned correction should restore mature adult face planes and source-relative lean-average widths while holding head-plus-hair near 34–35% and preserving every other passing feature.
